note: WAEC Chemistry round 6 (R31 top-up): titration volume by ratio; percentage yield 75; hydrogen in excess; 8 g NaOH in 2 dm3 as 0.1 mol/dm3; one faraday 96,500 C; silver chloride white, lilac potassium flame, blue Cu(II) precipitate, ammonia blues damp litmus; ionisation energy rises across a period; fog as colloid; air 78% nitrogen and next argon; methane from herds and paddies; oxygen from liquid air; lime sweetens soil; ion-exchange softener; breaking absorbs, making releases; fridge slows spoilage; concentration crowds collisions; catalyst unchanged; exothermic delta H negative; removing product shifts right; aluminium most abundant; pig iron; tin cans; solder; bronze; hydrogenated oils; ethene into polythene; sour wine to ethanoic acid; alkanols CnH2n+1OH; blue vitriol loses its water; parallax; sharp melting point of purity; steam to condensation.
